Necessity per prerequisite: the success status needs the invocation contract for the completion it codes and each refusal for the without-refusal boundary it draws — without any of them, coding 0 is motiveless. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: status 0 contradicts no refusal clause; no prerequisite fixes any other success status. Fail on any contradiction.
content.rationale: The success half of the status function; the gate forces the boundary to track every refusal.
